title: He won’t eat you
html_source:
The citizen is referring to the growling dog at the bar.
The Cyclops ate several of the men with Ulysses after the crew ate some of the food in his cave.

anchor.prefix:
a heavy heart he bewept the extinction of that beam of heaven. 

1939#220

 Old Garryowen started growling again at Bloom that was skeezing round the door. 

 — Come in, come on,
anchor.suffix:
, says the citizen. 

 So Bloom slopes in with his cod's eye on the dog and he asks Terry was Martin Cunningham there. 

 — O, Christ M'Keown, says Joe, reading one of the letters.
